text:
Maria Gomez: Starting catalog cutover for helix-9b in eu-west-1. Change window 15:00-16:00 UTC. Canary at 2% for 10m -> ramp to 10%. Pin list attached. Please watch fallback ordering closely (we want quant-9b preferred as fallback).

deploy-bot: Deploy job created: https://deploy.redwood/ops/12345 status: pending :gear:

Kevin Liu: @Maria what's the fallback TTL and eviction policy? We ran into cascade evictions last time.

Maria Gomez: Posting the fallback config we'll use:
```
fallback_order:
  - quant-9b
  - helix-9b-quant
  - base-7b
pin_duration: 15m
eviction_policy: proactive
eviction_threshold: 0.7
```

devx-bot: Canary config applied: traffic=2% for 10m, auto-ramp to 10% if metrics OK. Rollback triggers enabled.

Sanjay Patel: Can we codify the rollback signals here? Need clear thresholds for on-call.

Maria Gomez: Rollback rules: error_rate > 3% sustained for 5m OR p50 latency > 300ms for 10m triggers immediate rollback. Also model-quality regressions on canary eval > 1.5% (regress-a set) should trigger manual review.

Iona Park: I'll run smoke tests on EU canary once it's live. Ping me when rollout starts. :eyes:

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started -> eu-west-1 (3 canary instances). Job 12345 -> running :rocket:

Iona Park: Smoke results: generation check OK, embeddings OK, streaming had 1 drop. latency p50=180ms, p95=520ms, errors=0.5%. Attaching quick logs snippet.

Maria Gomez: Good first look. Monitor for 10m and then ramp to 10% if stable.

devx-bot: Canary stable after 12m. Auto-ramp executed -> traffic now 10% :white_check_mark:

Kevin Liu: Locking pin on helix-9b-1.2 for 24h.

Maria Gomez: Noted. We'll hold the pin and keep the fallback ordering as posted. If rollback needed we revert traffic back to quant-9b and drain helix gracefully.

deploy-bot: Model pinned: helix-9b-1.2 -> pin_id=pin-789. Canary->prod timeline logged.

Iona Park: Adding prompt set 'regress-a' to the watchlist and a quick nightly eval check.

Maria Gomez: Thanks everyone. Closing cutover window at 16:00 UTC. Final release notes: https://docs.redwood/release/helix-9b-1.2
